propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys became inert after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port that was their only reader
The keys were live and behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1, with operator-facing documentation directing users to set them, making hard removal a genuine upgrade hazard
Both keys must remain in the schema as deprecated entries that parse and validate unchanged while emitting a scheduled retirement warning naming removal in v1.0.0
The write-only Jira DataCenter transport plumbing (_resolved_statuses attribute, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant, backend constructor kwarg) must be removed since nothing reads the stored value
A follow-up ticket (f408) must be filed and linked to record the operator sign-off decision needed before hard removal via tombstone warnings can proceed
